review_scope: VIS-08 v2 reader 23-test R4 runner and no-Cargo preflight; no Cargo, Nextest, tests, or CLI build was executed by reviewer.

reviewed_contract.selection: Exact 23 nextest_result::tests names, one --lib target, default ignored policy and exact filterset pinned in both runner and packet.
reviewed_contract.deadline: One monotonic 900000 ms deadline starts before packet/input snapshot; cache copy and tool version probes use remaining time; each child gets min(stage limit, remaining budget); later stages do not start after deadline; pass requires elapsed time through the final protected-input snapshot to remain within deadline.
reviewed_contract.cleanup: Process-group TERM/KILL/reap/pipe-close limits remain 5000 ms plus 5000 ms and are recorded separately from the work deadline.
reviewed_contract.isolation: Attempt root must be absent. Cargo home, target, HOME, TMP, logs, CLI output are fresh private descendants; offline mode and jobs=2 are pinned.
reviewed_contract.integrity: Runner rechecks exact 12-file package inventory/digest, source review and parent freeze/patch bindings, 85-file unused cache receipt and bytes, tools, and synthetic CLI fixture bytes before/after; source/fixture/cache identities are included in result.
reviewed_contract.output: 4 MiB combined stage cap and 1 MiB cap per synthetic CLI exercise; raw logs are create-new and retained.
reviewed_contract.evidence_limits: Packet explicitly labels product behavior NOT_TESTED and product acceptance NOT_ESTABLISHED; the two CLI exercises use synthetic inputs.

caveat: Elapsed pass/fail measurement includes the final protected-input snapshot; bounded process-group cleanup is separately allowed up to 10 seconds. Final receipt serialization and wrapper stdout occur after the elapsed value is captured, so this is not a hard-kill guarantee for the Node supervisor's own finalization path.
preflight: Supplied preflight is PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_CARGO_NO_TEST with authorized=false and fresh attempt root; it is not execution authorization.
